biotools.summary: Autoprot is a Python module designed to simplify the analysis of quantitative mass spectrometry-based proteomics data, particularly when processed with MaxQuant. It integrates Python and R algorithms, offering interactive visualizations for data exploration and streamlined analysis pipelines.
